subject: A newsletter corpus for your fund customers
body:
Your docs describe a workflow's source as the set of URLs it extracts from, with HTML, XML, RSS, JSON and PDF supported. That means a fund wanting newsletter coverage has to hand-build per-publication pipelines, one site at a time.

NewsletterFIT already holds more than 27,000 public newsletter publications and 143,000 articles, with companies, people, topics, guests and 2,200 sponsors extracted, and the article URL and date on every record. It could land as a licensed input beside your own collection rather than something you build.

Would a sample of 5,000 recent items for a sector you serve be useful? If you already ingest newsletters, say so and I will stop there.
